decisions.summary: Root cause of the ~5s timeout family is ALREADY fixed on main by fd7b0cbe1 (skip managed tmux-server founding under VITEST). The whole family passes fast now (verified in CI run 27472211377: fork-retry-limit ✓338ms, UAT ✓2936ms). No work is needed on codex.test.ts / conversations.test.ts / reviewer-tree.test.ts.

Scope is ONLY: re-land the @slow tagging that was collateral-reverted with d9807686d, and prove the Playwright UAT is excluded from the default vitest run. Replay exactly the two known-good hunks of d9807686d (vitest.config.ts tags/tagsFilter + the UAT describe tag).

vitest 4.1.6 supports tags/tagsFilter/strictTags. strictTags defaults to TRUE, so the @slow tag MUST be declared in test.tags before any describe uses it — otherwise vitest errors. This forces an ordering: config bead lands before the UAT-tag bead.
Add a `test:slow` npm script (`vitest run --tagsFilter @slow`) so the excluded @slow set stays runnable on demand instead of being silently orphaned.

Local verification suffices for THIS change because @slow exclusion is pure config-level tag filtering, evaluated identically local and CI — unlike the reverted fake-timer conversion whose behavior diverged (local ops succeed → green; CI ops fail → hang).

hazards.summary: Issue BODY says 'convert the family to fake timers' — this is STALE and WRONG. The operator's later comments re-scoped it: that conversion (d9807686d) hung both main CI jobs for the full 30-min budget and was reverted (53ac34014). Do NOT redo any fake-timer conversion of these tmux/IO suites.
hazards.mitigation: Treat operator comments as authoritative over the body. Plan does no fake-timer conversion; NonGoals forbid it explicitly. concerns.md updated with the hang trap.

hazards.summary: strictTags defaults to true. Tagging the UAT describe @slow WITHOUT declaring @slow in vitest.config test.tags makes vitest throw, reddening the whole suite.
hazards.mitigation: Land the config bead (declares @slow + tagsFilter) before the UAT-tag bead; encoded as a blocks edge. Do not introduce any other undeclared tag.

hazards.summary: A no-op re-land is possible if the wrong mechanism is used — the operator explicitly warned 'ONLY if verified effective'. The d9807686d mechanism IS the correct vitest 4.x API; it was never CI-proven only because the conversion in the same commit hung the job.
hazards.mitigation: Verify locally that default `vitest run` collects ZERO tests from the UAT file (e.g. `npx vitest run tests/playwright/conversation-supervisor-uat.test.ts` reports no tests run / filtered). This is a faithful CI proxy because the filter is deterministic config behavior.

hazards.summary: The UAT uses real chromium.launch() + playwright; running it on demand needs the chromium browser installed. The default CI run no longer needs it once excluded, but do not remove the workflow's chromium install in this issue.
